name: The Black Capes (GR) + Supp: Whirling in Rags (NO)
description:
The Black Capes:

The Black Capes are a prominent gothic rock band from Athens, Greece.

Throughout their career they have carved a distinct niche in the global underground, blending old-school gothic rock with modern elements. Their three albums (All these monsters, Lullabies for the dead, Looks like death) are filled with haunting melodies, crushing riffs and deep vocals.

Their evocative soundscapes and post punk anthems have landed them on the German alternative charts and secured them features in major print publications like Metal Hammer, Rock Hard, Legacy, Orkus, Sonic Seducer etc.

﻿A captivating live act, The Black Capes have toured continental Europe and the UK sharing prominent festival and club stages with darkwave and goth heavyweights such as Perturbator, Tribulation, Theatre of Hate, Soror Dolorosa, Then Comes Silence and many more.


Whirling In Rags:

What happens if you take the coldwave out of the club and into the woods? Dancing around the campfire to melodic stories, cold, yet intimate, told by vocalist Darija Dììs. We invite you to a world of twangy guitar, steady postpunk-bass and haunting synthscapes and melodies.
